= verbatim-order(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Substitution tests
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-01
:blank:
:word: expanded
:markup: *introduced*

== Name
verbatim-order - quote and attribute substitutions without macros

== Description

[subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes"]
----
A01 Before *{blank}* and *{word}* after. {markup}
  link:https://example.org[Literal] & <tag>
----

[subs="specialcharacters,attributes,quotes"]
----
A02 Before *{blank}* after. {markup}
----

[subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes"]
....
A03 Before _{blank}_ and _{word}_ after.
  second  line
....

[listing,subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes"]
A04 Before *{blank}* and *{word}* after.

[literal,subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes"]
A05 Before *{blank}* and *{word}* after.

[subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes"]
 A06 Before *{blank}* and *{word}* after.
   second  line

[subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes"]
```text
A07 Before *{blank}* and *{word}* after.
```

[subs="specialcharacters,quotes"]
----
A08 Keep *{word}* and link:https://example.org[Literal].
----

[subs="specialcharacters,attributes"]
----
A09 Keep *{word}* and {markup}.
----

[subs=none]
----
A10 Keep *{word}* and {markup}.
----

----
A11 Default *{word}* and {markup}.
----

[subs=+quotes]
----
A12 Keep *{word}* and *bold*.
----

[subs="specialcharacters,quotes,attributes"]
 A13 *First
   second* after.
